R1.reason: The live cut list carries no angle or taper for the Front Panel (5 degree bottom cut) or the Side Panels (5-5/8 short edge, 6 long edge); search of steps, cutList, description for /degree|angle|bevel|taper|short edge|long edge/ finds only steps[0] 'a couple angled cuts' with no value. Kreg's own cut-list text had them, so the importer dropped the trailing text; the Extras PDF is where the builder is sent. Fix not Unpublish: the box can be assembled and the parts cut to the corrected sizes; only the angle values are missing.

R2.reason: Parts named in steps (sides, back panel, bottom panel, front panel) = cutList rows 0-3; no other parts.
